name: Vizsla Silver Corp.
summary: Vizsla Silver Corp. engages in the acquisition, exploration, and development of mineral properties in Canada and Mexico. The company explores for silver and gold deposits. It owns Panuco West project located in the municipality of Concordia, southern Sinaloa state, and Sierra Madre Occidental physiographic province in western Mexico. The company was formerly known as Vizsla Resources Corp. and changed its name to Vizsla Silver Corp. in February 2021. Vizsla Silver Corp. was incorporated in 2017 and is headquartered in Vancouver, Canada.
